exact_statement: For disjoint compatible positive-width point blocks S,W,U,V of widths s,L,R,T and ANY independent Boolean sign g on a uniform cube, put q=2^-R,r=2^-T,eta=2^-(L+R+T),e=q+r-qr-eta,a=1-Eg,F=1+[WUV+S((U OR V)-WUV)](g-1),JB=(L+R+T)eta,JC=R q(1-r)+T r(1-q),JD=JB+JC. Under any finite adaptive history revealing only fresh S and core-data bits with W,U,V unexposed, stop separator accounting at S failure or completion. Every live S query at remaining length j>=4 is strictly K4-good whenever its influence is positive; if a e<=1/16 every layer is good. If min(R,T)>=4 every layer is good for arbitrary conditional bias. Choose the fixed original-geometry cutoff m*=0 in that wide regime and 3 otherwise. At live states let M_j=min(j,m*) and U_j(g)=2^-j[a M_j JD+a e M_j(M_j-1)/2+M_j e I(g)], with U=0 at separator termination. The exact S drift is the actual face price c_j=2^-j[a(JD+(j-1)e)+e I(g)] at j<=m* and zero otherwise. At a physical core query i the exact owned reserve release is 2^-j M_j e Inf_i(g), between zero and 3 Inf_i(F). Thus eligible S-face debits plus these core releases plus expected stopped U telescope exactly to U_root. The actual strict-K4 bad separator-face bill is at most U_root<=3 I_other+I_sep+3 I_terminal<=3 I(F), where I_sep=s 2^-s a e,I_other=a[(1-2^-s)JB+2^-s JC],I_terminal=(eta+2^-s e)I(g). No actual core-query entropy, biased later-union prefix, terminal entropy or prescribed-reference/reset payment is inferred. In the actual six-bit instance s=L=R=T=1,g=(-1,1,1,1), the first core query has D_F-pi D_g-owned_release>3429/100000>0, with pi=7/16,D_g=2,owned_release=5/32, so the corresponding release-only local entropy-payment inequality is false.
